sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Janardan Yadav

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Ajay Bhanot,J.
By means of the bail application the applicant has prayed to be enlarged on bail in Case Crime No.256 of 2023 at Police Station-Nijamabad, District-Azamgarh under Sections 376-D, 506 IPC.
The applicant is in jail since 13.06.2023.
The bail application of the applicant was rejected by the learned trial court on 27.06.2023.

The following arguments made by Shri Janardan Yadav, learned counsel on behalf of the applicant,
which could not be satisfactorily refuted by Ms. Nidhi Rai, learned counsel on behalf of the informant and Shri Chandan Agrawal, learned AGA from the record, entitle the applicant for grant of bail:
Phukuli vs State Of U.P. on 18 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/159106071/
1
1. Delay in lodgment of the FIR in the facts of this case is fatal to the prosecution case.
2. The applicant has been nominated on account of a petty village rivalry.
3. There are material contradictions in the prosecution case set out in the FIR by the victim and her statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C. which discredit the prosecution case.
4. Medical evidence to corroborate commission of rape by the applicant with the victim has not been produced by the prosecution.

5. The applicant claims congruency in role and seeks parity in relief granted to the co-accused Salmaan who has been enlarged on bail by this Court by order dated 15.09.2023 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 40234 of 2023.
6.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 40234 of 2023
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: The applicant has explained his criminal history.
It is also contended that the applicant is a convenient scapegoat for the police authorities.
The applicant has been falsely nominated in a number of cases only to show the proficiency of the police investigators.
The said cases do not have any bearing on the instant bail application.
7. The applicant is not a flight risk.
The applicant being a law abiding citizen has always cooperated with the investigation and undertakes to join the trial proceedings.
There is no possibility of his influencing witnesses, tampering with the evidence or reoffending.
In the light of the preceding discussion and without making any observations on the merits of the case, the bail application is allowed.
Let the applicant-Phukuli be released on bail in the aforesaid case crime number, on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court below.

The following conditions be imposed in the interest of justice:-
(i) The applicant will not tamper with the evidence or influence any witness during the trial.
(ii) The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.

Order Date :- 18.9.2023 Vandit  Phukuli vs State Of U.P. on 18 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/159106071/
